newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 02.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 02.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iran vital to Gulf security says Qatar.
- MashreqBank -- the country's leading private sector local bank -- posted a record net profit of 350.49 million dirhams for the year ending December 31, 1996.
- Sudan accepts United Arab Emirates offer to mediate in the fighting in the east of the country.
- Iraq denies that it was massing troops along its southern border in a threat to Kuwait.
- BCCI payout to UAE depositors by month-end.
- Income boom brought on by stronger oil prices should not affect reforms in Gulf states, expert says.
- UAE Minister of State for Finance and Industrial Affairs says the country's economy is strong and the banking sector enjoys confidence.
- UAE reaffirms its commitment to Sudan's sovereignty.
